observations: All sampled hard records use two factors, integer positive exponents 1..5, one product/power expansion, supplied numeric or symbolic logarithms, short signed arithmetic, five radio choices. Negative given logarithms are valid because x=b^u>0, y=b^v>0. They add signed arithmetic but no new logarithm operation or solution stage. The alternative banks contain answers of the same numeric/affine type.
restrictions: x/y/k labels fixed and base>1 conservative finite base set: renaming labels is incidental, not a missing decision case. Numeric keeps two nonunit unequal exponents; symbolic keeps one unit exponent and one symbolic given, matching two observed hard workload profiles. Both symbolic and powered-factor assignments vary independently.
